scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to odd \(n\ge3\) and to the three full Pauli-parity coordinates. It gives the exact envelope of the stated weighted-witness/Pinsker mechanism, not an exact formula for total correlation and not an entanglement measure. The even-party weighted optimization is not claimed. The depolarizing statement concerns certificate positivity, not disappearance of physical correlation.
title: Optimal odd-party Pauli-parity total-correlation envelope
